title: The Military camp outside the town
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：military　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 military 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the counsellor wrote of ① a military camp outside the town in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② so military that nobody in the garden would go near it. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the military ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the military camp outside the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1963 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too military to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the military ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a military rule of the region, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as military as the rule of the region they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was military or not, and he said so.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something military, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite military; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the military ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another military camp outside the town in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed ⑨ no less military than anybody had expected. ⑩ The military rule of the region that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1981, was the one she could never quite name; the military ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 军事（前置定语 a military camp outside the town：1969 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件军事的军营）
B. adj. 军事／军队（两处加强说法：so military that … 与 no less military than …）
C. adj. 军事／军队（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 军事（表语 too military to do：母亲觉得它太军事，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 军队（前置定语 a military rule of the region：叔叔把整件事称作一桩军队的军管）
F. adj. 军队（同级比较 as military as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩该地区的军管相比）
G. adj. 军队（后置定语 something military：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 军队（受程度副词修饰 quite military：那位倾听者的评价）

items.q: a military camp outside the town
the military camp outside the town that
a military rule of the region
The military rule of the region that

answers.why: military 意为“军事”，1969 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件军事的军营”，此处作前置定语 a military camp outside the town。
military 意为“军事”，此处用 so military that 结构，说它军事到小园里没人敢靠近。
military 意为“军事”，心记上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的军事城外的军营，等于最高级的说法。
military 意为“军事”，母亲认为这件东西“太军事了，谁也用不上”，too military to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
military 意为“军队”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩军队的军管”，此处作前置定语 a military rule of the region。
military 意为“军队”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩该地区的军管一样军队”，同级比较用 as military as。
military 意为“军队”，心记上那半行字要的是“军队的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something military。
military 意为“军队”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当军队”，quite 修饰原级 military。
military 意为“军队”，no less military than 表示“其军队不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之军队不亚于任何人的预料。
military 意为“军队”，母亲 1981 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的军队军管”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件军事的军营。（a military camp outside the town）
它军事到小园里没有一个人敢靠近。（so military that …）
母亲觉得它太军事，谁也用不上。（too military to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩军队的军管。（a military rule of the region）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩该地区的军管一样军队。（as military as …）
到了 1976 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件军队的东西。（something military）
answers: In 1969 the counsellor wrote of a military camp outside the town in the journal.
It was so military that nobody in the garden would go near it.
My mother thought it too military to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a military rule of the region.
He said nobody would call it as military as the rule of the region they had once had.
By 1976 the journal asked for nothing but something military.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 military 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the counsellor wrote of a military camp outside the town in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the military camp outside the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too military to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a military rule of the region, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite military, and everybody laughed.
The military ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
